mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sso_ticket (jti, issuer, user_id, redirect_url, used_yn, issued_at, expires_at) VALUES (#{jti}, #{issuer}, #{userId}, #{redirectUrl}, 0, DATEADD(HOUR, 9, GETUTCDATE()), #{expiresAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE sso_ticket SET used_yn = 1 WHERE jti = #{jti} AND used_yn = 0 AND expires_at > DATEADD(HOUR, 9, GETUTCDATE())
